nom: CHANEL LE LIFT SÉRUM Smooths - Firms

avis.texte: I have been using Chanel products since 1998 and I am always grateful that I can relax with regard to my skin care. I only use 2 of their products but I stick with them. !
Fantastic. I used to use Lancome and Este Lauder. But this is better.

I absolutely love this product! You can't go wrong with this!The sheer coverage is beautiful! I love the idea of a lifting serum with pigmentation but not quite a foundation. I highly recommend using the blending blush after applying with your fingertips for a flawless finish. Chanel knows beauty!

avis.titre: I love it!! One tiny dot goes a long way.
avis.texte: Although this product is a bit pricey for me (I'm on a senior budget), I think it will go a long long way. I really love it. I've used it for one week and already can see a difference in my skin.
I had very deep wrinkles on my forehead, and around my mouth after one month of using this product. It really helped with the appearance of the fine lines.

avis.titre: I'm shocked at these scathing reviews
avis.texte: I don't have sensitive skin so I can't attest to irritation, but I do know a quality product when I see one. This is it! I absolutely love le lift serum for nighttime use. Sometimes I use clarins double serum, sometimes I use an Elizabeth Arden retinol, but I find myself reaching for this one more and more because of its incredible results. In just a week of using le left serum (I usually lock it in with Chanel revitalizing cream), I saw my faint forehead lines disappear — literally. It feels very nice on the skin and smells like a clean, natural, relaxing floral. This product makes me look forward to my skincare routine, whereas others I've tried (like *gag* drunk elephant) are extremely unpleasant in texture and make me dread using them. For this 27 year old working mom of 2, there is no better serum for keeping my skin looking sexy, youthful and well-rested. Ps: Don't complain about alcohol in a serum; educate yourself instead.

Way overly fragrant. It's irritating to my skin and I don't have sensitive skin. I used it for a couple nights and couldn't get past the smell and irritation. Why do brands insist on adding fragrance to their products?! No thank you!!

I have many samples of this product and use it undernearth the Chanel Camellia Water Cream for added skincare benefits. It really smooths out fine lines on the forehead and near the eyes. Just the combo of these two products looks fresh enough to not have to wear any makeup for the day if I don't feel like it.

avis.titre: I love it and see the difference
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a few months now and I love it. My skin feels and looks plump, refreshed and luxurious.

I'm 23 years old and because ive lacked a lot of sunscreen throughout the entirety of my life. Ive started to notice fine lines growing on my forehead. Since I started using this my skin has been visibly more plumped and my fine lines are slowly disappearing. A little goes a long way! Also don't let the stupid person below who knows nothing about skincare saying "beware of alcohol" for some people. Alcohol is necessary in a product to help allow the ingredients penetrate deeper into your skin. Know how ingredients work before making false claims under the reviews tab.
